page.layout: One printed page of text, centred headings above, then one italic paragraph. No marginal notes. Page number top right. Signature "A" and catchword "Ut" at the foot.

main_text.head: CELSISSIME ET ILLUSTRISSIME PRINCEPS LUDOVICE HENRICE, NASSOVIUS SANGUIS DIGNISSIMUS, SPES PROXIMA ET AUGUSTA PATRIÆ, MUSARUM NOSTRARUM MÆCENAS SPLENDIDISSIME, EXOPTATISSIME.
DOMINE CLEMENTISSIME.
main_text.p: ILLUSTRIS ET GENEROSISSIME COMES, SANGUINIS SOLMENSIS TRADUX, ET MARTIO ARDORE INCLUTE.

p.i: Amplissime, & Excellentissime Themidis Mysta, & Jurium in Vetustissima Heidelbergensi Academia Antecessor ac Pro-cancellarie Celeberrime. Nobilissime & Inclute Aulæ Nassovicæ Præfecte. Nobilissimi & Amplissimi Viri, Celsissimo Principi nostro à Consiliis meritissimi, Reverendi, Consultissimi, Experientissimi ac Clarissimi Facultatum ac Artium Antecessores, Collegæ honorandi. Nobilissime Domine Deputate. Reverendi divinorum Eloquiorum Præcones. Præstantissimi & Spectatissimi pubis Scholasticæ Formatores. Spectatissime Archigrammatee, & Consules Urbis Prudentissimi. Honoratissimi cujuscunque ordinis Hospites & gratissimi. Tuque lectissima & florentissima Studiosæ juventutis Corona.

page.notes: The faint text at the top left and the faint lines in the right half of the page are show-through from the reverse and were not transcribed. The ornamental band above the title is a printer's ornament, not text.
